# OMP Strata

> Profile, lifecycle tool and acceptance evidence for running the stock Oh My Pi (OMP) coding agent against
> a stock, local Strata inference server on one Windows 11 + RTX host. It forks neither project and adds no
> proxy: every download is pinned by URL, size and SHA-256; stock `setup.py` runs unmodified from verified
> local inputs; Strata binds to loopback behind an API key; stock OMP runs in an isolated profile with every
> model role on the local server and no cloud fallback. Python standard library only. Qualified and current (2026-11-09):
> stock Strata v0.2.13 (engine 0.1.59) + stock OMP 18.18.3 across the RTX PRO 6000 (plus its tuned-DFlash2 v0.2.13 alternate), the RTX 5090 262K Coder IQ1_M default, 131K Coder IQ1_M alternative and full-model IQ3_S 131K low-RAM resident alternate, the RTX 4090 + RTX 3090 pair and the Mac Studio route (plus its tuned-DFlash2 v0.2.13 alternate): on the
> RTX 4090 + RTX 3090 pair in `rtx3090-win-a` (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next IQ3_S at the trained 262,144-token context, stock
> roles `--gpu-roles 0=main,1=helper` putting the RTX 4090 as Main staged last, manual layer split 24 `--layer-split 24`,
> stage dense-weight trim `--trim-stage-weights` (`strata.trim_stage_weights: true`), stock DFlash2 drafting alone
> via `strata.drafting: "dflash2"` (`--draft dflash2 --draft-model <root>\data\dflash2\qwen3.8-flash-next-dflash2.q4_0-selq4.pack --draft-fallback none --draft-conf 0.5 --draft-vocab <root>\data\dflash2\draft_vocab.bin`,
> packed offline during `install` by stock `tools/dflash2_pack.py` from pinned `incoai/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-DFlash2` files
> with `STRATA_NO_ACQUIRE=1`) and `strata.drafting_args` pinning `{"--draft-conf": "0.5"}` (`df2conf05`, stock's slot-step
> value for the pair's per-card slots, which stock cannot compute on a split, written to stock `user_args` with stock
> `write_config` and required on the start's server line), dropping `--pipeline-windows 2` and sizing the expert caches at
> 19.40 GiB on the RTX 3090 and 17.90 GiB on the RTX 4090 vs 19.41 / 17.90 GiB on v0.2.11 `df2`, 19.41 / 18.31 GiB on
> v0.2.10 `df2` and 19.14 / 17.75 GiB on the v0.2.10 `pw2` (`--pipeline-windows 2`) `env86g` multi-token prediction (MTP)
> alternative, no batch slots, display on the RTX 4090, `strata.ple_io: "direct"` pinning stock `--ple-io direct` to keep
> the 26.8 GiB per-layer embedding (PLE) table on direct SSD reads, preserving the engine's 8,192 MiB automatic
> conversation cache, and `strata.engine_env` pinning the engine's `sm_86` default table `sm86_table`, stock `gdn_stack`
> and two-pass QSA block selection `select_two_pass` (`STRATA_SELECT_TWO_PASS=1`; the `df2conf05` and `env86gt` ids drop
> `-parking` only to stay within the 120-character profile-id limit, with the same `strata.stock_tips`), which in three
> paired cold starts (`A1 B1 B2 A2 A3 B3`, reporting `B / A` geometric means under the owner's 5% non-regression rule)
> against the v0.2.12 `env86gt` pair profile passed all 96 plain checks with targeted cold decode at
> 1.021 (`[1.020, 1.049, 0.993]`; throughput 1.016 / 0.998, per-request 1.027 / 0.993, TTFT p50 1.005 / 1.001, TPOT p50
> 0.973 / 1.009, decode 100K 1.061, warm 32K 1.054, 32K 1.044) and, after `fb8740a` fixed `install` verification for
> stock v0.2.13's `carry_user_args`, passed every gate including G15, G17, G18 and G18L in the 2026-11-09 requalification
> chain at `7c2d25e` (`440fa1b`) with G24 16/18 and `tool-loop` 1/3 under `"Run the --draft-conf 0.5 main; it becomes
> current if every gate passes"`;
> `win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-262k-df2conf05-disp4090-roles-split24-trimweights-pledirect-env86gt-strata0.2.13-omp18.18.3`;
> [ledger](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-262k-df2conf05-disp4090-roles-split24-trimweights-pledirect-env86gt-strata0.2.13-omp18.18.3/qualification.json);
> rolling back to the v0.2.12 `env86gt` two-pass DFlash2 profile
> `win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-262k-df2-disp4090-roles-split24-trimweights-pledirect-env86gt-strata0.2.12-omp18.18.0`,
> [ledger](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-262k-df2-disp4090-roles-split24-trimweights-pledirect-env86gt-strata0.2.12-omp18.18.0/qualification.json),
> qualified at `57dcd18` (`953a31f`) with `--draft-conf 0.35`, G10 28.21 GiB commit headroom of 135.69 GiB and 65.74 GiB
> available RAM, G16/G20/G21 55.4 / 55.3 / 55.5 s, lowest available RAM 57.00 GiB in G18L, G17 near-limit task 57.7 s,

> Operating condition for the RTX 5090 262K default: the host's Docker Desktop and WSL, which run its production NInfer
> container, must be stopped; after WSL restarts, that container must be recreated by the owner's pinned relaunch script
> or returned through the owner's fleet controller (a WSL-up start was refused at 7.3 GiB available RAM while another of
> the owner's agents held host memory; untested on an idle host). The 131,072-token Coder IQ1_M profile
> (`win11-rtx5090-coder-iq1m-131k-strata0.2.13-omp18.18.3`;

> is the current 131K alternative for running with Docker Desktop and WSL up (the production container stopped by the
> fleet controller; qualified on the same window's passing 262K A/B without a separate A/B, as in v0.2.12, with every gate passing, G24 16/18, published at `d0c2e28`; 34 GiB start floor),
> rolling back to `win11-rtx5090-coder-iq1m-131k-strata0.2.12-omp18.18.0` (3,584 MiB cache with 19 parks in G19, G10 11.37 GiB available RAM and 18.72 GiB commit headroom of 85.15 GiB, G15 recall 30.9-32.0 s, 16.6-18.9 s restart readiness in the Docker/WSL-stopped window, lowest available RAM 7.08 GiB in G19; `win11-rtx5090-coder-iq1m-131k-strata0.2.10-omp18.16.0`, `win11-rtx5090-coder-iq1m-131k-strata0.2.9-omp18.15.0` and `win11-rtx5090-coder-iq1m-131k-strata0.2.8-omp18.14.0`

> stock's planner pick for this host, keeping 11,616 expert slots in VRAM at 22.04 GiB and 29.77 GiB of experts page-locked in RAM; report-only screen `B = IQ3_S` vs `A = Coder IQ1_M 131K` on v0.2.13 measured cold decode 1.046 at 8K, 1.093 at 32K, 1.071 at 100K and 1.094 on warm 32K vs 0.763 at the empty prompt, queue decode 1.086 / 1.086, per-request 1.134 / 1.129, TPOT p50 0.881 / 0.885, throughput `w1` 1.059 and `w3` 0.917, TTFT p50 1.528 at 512 tokens and 1.122 at 32K, and prefill 0.61-0.95, with 58/60 vs Coder 54/60 on the earlier private quality set)

> upstream's [Niko1221/Strata#4518](https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/issues/4518) fix locked the 26.8 GiB PLE table

> Oh My Pi maintainers, the Strata maintainer, Qwen or NVIDIA.

## Install

- From a checkout, with the current candidate profile: `validate` → `fetch` → `install` → `keygen` →
  `start` → `launch-omp` → `stop` (`py -3 scripts\omp_strata.py <command> --profile <profile> --root <root>`).
- One integration root per candidate; nothing is written to the user's normal OMP configuration or to
  `%APPDATA%\Strata`.

## Boundaries

- Supported: the qualified profiles under `profiles/` (Windows 11, a single NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000, RTX 5090, RTX 3090
  or RTX 4090, or the RTX 4090 + RTX 3090 layer-split pair; every other profile is a draft or a rollback installation),
  text only, single user, loopback only.
- Remote use: the Mac Studio's current qualified route,
  `client-rtxpro6000-262k-df2-pledirect-kvvram-envpg-strata0.2.13-omp18.18.3`, runs stock OMP 18.18.3 through an
  SSH local forward to `win11-rtxpro6000-iq3s-262k-slots4-df2-pledirect-kvvram-envpg-parking-strata0.2.13-omp18.18.3`,
  the PRO's current v0.2.13 262K `df2` DFlash2 profile (G23 pass on 2026-11-09, published at `2af52b8`: missing key
  refused before launch, wrong key HTTP 401, health RTT 5.8-7.7 ms and stream TTFT 0.217 s; tunnel drop failed the turn
  in flight with the transcript preserved, and a one-turn `launch-omp` smoke answered `ROUTE OK`).
  Its qualified non-current alternate, `client-rtxpro6000-262k-df2tuned-pledirect-kvvram-envpg-strata0.2.13-omp18.18.3`,
  reaches the PRO's v0.2.13 262K `df2tuned` tuned-pack alternate (G23 pass on 2026-11-09, published at `8ab88b0`: health
  RTT 6.1-6.8 ms and stream TTFT 0.181 s, and a one-turn `launch-omp` smoke answered `ROUTE OK`).
  Its qualified rollback, `client-rtxpro6000-262k-df2-pledirect-kvvram-envpg-strata0.2.12-omp18.18.0`, reaches the
  PRO's v0.2.12 262K `df2` DFlash2 rollback (G23 pass on 2026-11-07 at `243290e`: missing key refused before launch, wrong
  key 401, health RTT 5.9-7.4 ms and stream TTFT 0.247 s; tunnel drop failed the turn in flight with the prior
  transcript preserved, nonce recall passed after tunnel reopen 0.87 s, client restart 0.79 s and verified server
  restart 2.56 s, and a one-turn `launch-omp` smoke answered `ROUTE OK` with owned stop). The 0.2.12 `df2tuned`, 0.2.11 `df2`, 0.2.11 `batchmtp`, 0.2.10 `kvvram-envpg`,
  0.2.9 `kvvram-envpg`, 0.2.9 batch-MTP base, 0.2.8 batch-MTP, 0.2.8 `slots4-parking`, 0.2.7, 0.2.3, 0.2.1, 0.1.44.1,
  0.1.43.1, 0.1.43 and 0.1.42 262K routes and `client-rtxpro6000-strata0.1.41-omp18.8.6` 131K route stay earlier history.
- Not supported: images, remote clients other than those qualified current, alternate and rollback Mac-to-RTX PRO 6000 routes, other
  operating systems, durable engine state across restarts, multiple tenants. Comparisons with other runtimes are
  separate, comparison-only tools.
- Security: loopback only, API key required on every model, control and metrics route, key in a user-only
  file, ambient provider credentials scrubbed from OMP's environment, no telemetry. Not a sandbox, a
  multi-tenant service or an egress firewall.

## Canonical documents

- [README](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata#readme): status, what the tool does, layout, host-free checks
- [Quickstart](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/QUICKSTART.md): the tested install, start, use and stop commands
- [Operations](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/OPERATIONS.md): lifecycle, recovery, logs, upgrades, requalifying a new tuple
- [Security](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/SECURITY.md): what is and is not isolated, observed egress, known defects
- [Measurements](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/MEASUREMENTS.md): resources, throughput, context, restart cost, evaluation results
- [Decision](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/DECISION.md): integration readiness, usefulness, further investment
- [Baseline](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/BASELINE.md): the frozen component tuple and why it was chosen
- [Upstream](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/UPSTREAM.md): findings reported to Strata and Oh My Pi
- [Release ledgers](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/tree/main/releases): manifest, gate ledger, receipts and scrubbed evidence per profile
